transform.mapping: x/1000, z/1000, -y/1000; then centre on the combined bounding box

changes: Selected 3 source OBJ files from the official BodyParts3D 4.0 tables.
Merged each structure's source parts into one selectable mesh: 3 selectable nodes.
Converted millimetres and the Z-up axis to metres and Y-up, centred the combined model, and recomputed vertex normals.
Exported one uncompressed GLB with stable mesh names. No source colours or textures are used; surface colours are ours.
No teaching text is stored in the model or seed; the module is unpublished pending faculty review.
adaptations: Grouped source files by the OBJ header Concept ID and English name so each named structure is one selectable node.
Large FMA systems are split into independently seeded modules because the viewer supports one GLB per system and each GLB must stay below the release budget.

orientation.viewer: Camera looks from +Z toward the origin; patient left is +X (the viewer's right). The viewer renders no on-screen orientation marker.
